mechanism: Compute swing range from prior daily candle (or LookbackSize array high/low); direction = close>open bullish else bearish. Entry levels = high−range×fib%/100 (bull) or low+range×fib%/100 (bear) for custom ratios (default 50,61.8). Signal on close cross of a level; array mode recalculates only after bid breaches stored 0–100 Fib extremes (IsBreach). Optional SL/TP as % of range buffers.
data_needed: D1 or chart OHLC; fibLevelsStr; LookbackSize; UseDailyApproach; close[1]/close[2] cross; bid vs currentHigh/Low
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol any; daily approach PERIOD_D1 prior bar; array approach chart _Period lookback default 100
why_new_for_mis: Pullback-location sensor: maps swing range into ratio levels and treats breach of the Fib envelope as a regime-reset event for MIS retracement context.
quote: For a bullish setup, after an upward swing from low to high, retracement levels like 50% or 61.8% act as potential buy zones during pullbacks

mechanism: Candle Range Theory phases on RangeTF: Accumulation = prior bar high/low range with close>open polarity; Manipulation = bid breach beyond range extreme with optional MinManipPct = manipDepth/rangeSize×100 filter; Distribution = ConfirmBars closes back inside on ConfirmTF then trade opposite the breach (positive range→SSL raid→buy; negative→BSL raid→sell).
data_needed: RangeTF OHLC; UseManipFilter/MinManipPct; ConfirmTF ConfirmBars; breachPoint extreme; ActivePositions caps
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: RangeTF default PERIOD_H4; ConfirmTF PERIOD_CURRENT; any symbol
why_new_for_mis: Three-phase CRT/AMD regime sensor treating liquidity-raid breaches as manipulation then distribution reversal.
quote: accumulation, where price consolidates within a defined range... manipulation, where price briefly breaches the range extremes to trap traders... and distribution, where the true directional move unfolds

mechanism: At SessionStartTime (HH:MM) capture opening-range high/low over RangeDurationMinutes on RangeTF; after rangeDefined, detect ask>rangeHigh or bid<rangeLow; optional ConfirmBars closes outside range on RangeTF before entry. Dynamic SL/TP from range size×RR_Ratio or static points; one trade per direction per session.
data_needed: SessionStartTime; RangeDurationMinutes; RangeTF H/L updates; breakout flags; ConfirmBars closes
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any session (NYSE 09:30, London 08:00, Asian, custom); RangeTF default PERIOD_M5; duration default 30 min
why_new_for_mis: Session-timed volatility envelope sensor: opening-range size and confirmed breakout direction as an intraday momentum-regime event for MIS.
quote: the opening range often represents the battle between buyers and sellers as the market digests overnight news and order flow, and a clean breakout signals that one side has won control

mechanism: Detect 3-candle FVGs (bullish: low0>high2; bearish: low2>high0) with minPts gap; track Normal→Mitigated (far-side break)→Retraced (re-entry)→Inverted (close beyond far side from inside after retrace). Trade bullish IFVG when mitigated bearish FVG closes above high; bearish IFVG when mitigated bullish closes below low. Ignore overlaps; cap tracked FVGs.
data_needed: 3-bar OHLC gaps; FVGState enum; mit/ret/inverted flags; minPts; ignoreOverlaps; tradeMode per FVG
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: _Symbol/_Period recent bars; historical FVG load on init from visible bars
why_new_for_mis: Stateful imbalance/liquidity-void sensor with inversion as the tradeable regime flip — richer than static FVG fill detection.
quote: An Inverse Fair Value Gap (IFVG) occurs when a mitigated FVG (price broke the far side) is retraced into and then inverted by price closing beyond the far side from inside

mechanism: Confirm swings over SwingLength L/R neighbors; label HH/HL/LH/LL vs prior swing. BoS sets MarketTrend (+1 on HH, −1 on LL). Sweep = prior bar wick beyond current swing (SSL below low / BSL above high) but close back inside on a directional candle. Buy SSL sweeps in bullish BoS; sell BSL sweeps in bearish BoS; SL beyond sweep extreme + buffer.
data_needed: SwingLength; current_swing_high/low; MarketTrend; iLow/iHigh/iClose/iOpen bar1 vs swing; SL_Buffer_Pips
why_new_for_mis: Explicit SSL/BSL liquidity-sweep sensor gated by Break-of-Structure trend — trap-then-reverse liquidity event for MIS.
quote: a sweep happens when price wicks beyond the swing (SSL below low in uptrend, BSL above high in downtrend) but closes inside on a directional candle, indicating trap of stops before true move.

mechanism: Load Free Indicators NRTR Channel (ATR period×multiplier). Buy when CurrentUpSupport becomes valid while PreviousUpSupport was EMPTY (start of long support); sell when CurrentDownSupport emerges from EMPTY. Optional trail SL to moving NRTR support levels (TRAILING_SUPPORT_LEVELS) or points; ATR-scaled SL/TP in auto mode; hedge-capable opposing positions.
data_needed: iCustom NRTR buffers: ATR(5), trend dir(4), upSupport(1), downSupport(2); EMPTY_VALUE transitions; NRTR_ATR_Period/Multiplier
why_new_for_mis: Volatility-adaptive trailing-channel regime sensor: support birth/death from ATR envelope marks trend-reversal flips for MIS.
quote: Entry signals occur when a new support level appears, initiating a buy position at the start of an upward support (long channel) or a sell position at the beginning of a downward support (short channel)

mechanism: HTF swing trend; detect consolidation via equal highs/lows within OBMaxDeviation over OBRangeCandles; require impulsive breakout (close beyond range×OBImpulseThreshold within OBWaitBars) plus FVG in impulse and opposing last consol candle as OB. Trade mitigated/unmitigated OB retests per tradeMode aligned to HTF trend.

why_new_for_mis: Institutional-zone sensor requiring inducement-before-BOS — filters false OB breaks by demanding a liquidity grab then structure break.
quote: Before a genuine break of structure occurs, price frequently makes a minor swing in the opposing direction to trigger retail stop losses and collect liquidity — this engineered move is the inducement.

mechanism: Confirm pivots with InpSwingLookback bars each side; merge into alternating zig-zag (keep more extreme same-type). Bearish QM: H-L-H-L with Head>Shoulder, Leg<Shoulder, BOS<Leg; bullish mirror. Optional IsPriorTrendConfirmed (same-type pivots stair-step into shoulder). Arm QM line at Left Shoulder; enter on retrace to QM line (optional rejection close); SL beyond Head (+ATR floor); TP RR or structural broken leg.
data_needed: SwingPivot zig-zag; InpSwingLookback; InpTrendPivots; ArmedSetup qmLine/head/target; InpMaxWaitBars; ATR stop floor

quote: It belongs to the same family as the head-and-shoulders formation, but it reframes the structure around a liquidity sweep and a confirmed break of market structure rather than a symmetrical neckline.

Sell failed high sweeps (BSL grab); buy failed low sweeps (SSL grab). TP = RR multiple or opposite side of lookback range.
